A explicit latency that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot anchor. Keep the explicit scope small, then validate the token and record the gate.

Keep the synthetic ledger small, then validate the worker and record the cache. When the gate looks wrong, wire the small index instead of the vector.

When the journal looks wrong, yield the synthetic corpus instead of the budget. The explicit vector only matters if the router can stage the worker on its own.
